nodes.name: Load Config & Plan Ticket Search
nodes.notes: Validates every setting, computes the search window from the stored watermark.

nodes.name: Run Demo Aggregation
nodes.notes: Fictional tickets, mock HubSpot and mock LLM. Separate demo state, no network.

nodes.name: Enforce Sandbox
nodes.notes: Stops unless the portal is a sandbox or developer test account (SANDBOX_MODE=true).

nodes.name: HubSpot: Search Closed & Escalated Tickets
nodes.notes: POST /crm/v3/objects/tickets/search: closed or escalated since the watermark, oldest first, MAX_TICKETS_PER_RUN.

nodes.name: Prepare Tickets (Redact PII)
nodes.notes: Drops already-processed tickets, strips HTML, redacts emails, phone and card numbers, links and credentials.

nodes.name: HubSpot: Read Companies (ARR)
nodes.notes: Batch read of name, domain and ARR_COMPANY_PROPERTY.

nodes.name: HubSpot: Read Deals (ARR)
nodes.notes: Batch read of dealstage and ARR_DEAL_PROPERTY; only closed-won deals count toward ARR.

nodes.name: Compute ARR & Plan LLM Extraction
nodes.notes: Per-company ARR, then one extraction request per ticket using the prompt template in src/core/llm.js.

nodes.name: LLM: Anthropic Messages
nodes.notes: Anthropic Messages API. The key comes from $env.LLM_API_KEY at request time.

nodes.name: LLM: OpenAI-Compatible Chat
nodes.notes: OpenAI-compatible chat completions with JSON output. Works with any compatible endpoint via LLM_API_URL.

nodes.name: Cluster Feedback & ARR Impact
nodes.notes: Validates the JSON output, clusters by category and title similarity against the stored registry, sums ARR once per company.

nodes.name: Destination Router (Linear / Jira / Notion)
nodes.notes: Creates or updates one record per cluster in the configured destination (sandbox container unless live).

nodes.name: Destination: Create or Update Feedback Record
nodes.notes: Linear GraphQL, Jira REST v3 or Notion pages. Credentials are read from $env at request time.

nodes.name: Plan Ticket Stamps
nodes.notes: Optional: writes the cluster title and record key to TICKET_FEEDBACK_STAMP_PROPERTY.

nodes.name: Finalize Run
nodes.notes: Commits the watermark, processed tickets and registry (not in DRY_RUN), and fails the execution on any write failure.

nodes.name: Build Redacted Failure Alert
nodes.notes: Redacts tokens, API keys, webhook URLs and email addresses.

parameters.content:
## Support feedback aggregator: safety defaults
- **Demo mode** while HUBSPOT_PRIVATE_APP_TOKEN is a placeholder: fictional tickets, mock LLM, no network.
- **LLM_PROVIDER=mock** by default; ticket text is PII-redacted before any LLM call.
- **DRY_RUN=true**: extracts and clusters, writes nothing, leaves the watermark and registry untouched.
- **SANDBOX_MODE=true**: refuses production portals; syncs only to the sandbox Linear team / Jira project / Notion database.
- Failed extractions hold the watermark back and are retried. Failure alerts are redacted.
